title: How a Robotics News video gets out
subtitle: You do one small thing a video. Everything else happens by itself.

steps.title: The day's topics are chosen
steps.text: Early in the morning the news about robots is read and three topics are picked for the day.

steps.title: A video is made and shown to you
steps.text: Each topic becomes a short video with a voice, real footage and captions. You get a message here when one is ready.

note.title: Want something different?
note.text: Write what should change, a sentence or a shot, and you get it again. Or drop it.

steps.title: It goes out on TikTok
steps.text: On **Storrito Robotics News**, at its time of the day:
steps.small: On Mondays you get a short look back at the week.

promise: Nothing goes online without your yes.
